functions.name: qf_event_locator_quartet_valid
functions.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qf_event_locator_quartet_valid(
    object_type_value text,
    object_id_value text,
    object_version_value integer,
    object_revision_value bigint,
    allow_null boolean
) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE
AS $qf$
BEGIN
    IF object_type_value IS NULL AND object_id_value IS NULL
       AND object_version_value IS NULL AND object_revision_value IS NULL THEN
        RETURN COALESCE(allow_null, false);
    END IF;
    IF object_type_value IS NULL OR object_id_value IS NULL THEN
        RETURN false;
    END IF;
    RETURN COALESCE(CASE
        WHEN object_type_value = 'job' THEN object_id_value ~ '^JOB-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'research' THEN object_id_value ~ '^RSCH-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'conclusion' THEN object_id_value ~ '^CONC-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'experiment' THEN object_id_value ~ '^EXP-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'factor' THEN object_id_value ~ '^FAC-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'validation' THEN object_id_value ~ '^VAL-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'approval' THEN object_id_value ~ '^APR-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'paper' THEN object_id_value ~ '^PAPER-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'paper_run' THEN object_id_value ~ '^PRUN-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'review' THEN object_id_value ~ '^REV-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'capability' THEN object_id_value ~ '^CAP-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'snapshot' THEN object_id_value ~ '^DS-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'agent_run' THEN object_id_value ~ '^ARUN-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'tool_call' THEN object_id_value ~ '^TCALL-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'memo' THEN object_id_value ~ '^MEMO-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'notification' THEN object_id_value ~ '^NOTIF-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$' AND (object_version_value IS NULL OR object_version_value >= 1) AND (object_revision_value IS NULL OR object_revision_value >= 1)
        WHEN object_type_value = 'strategy_version' THEN
            object_id_value ~ '^STRAT-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$'
            AND object_version_value >= 1 AND object_revision_value >= 1
        WHEN object_type_value = 'settings' THEN
            object_id_value = 'SETTINGS-DEFAULT'
            AND object_version_value IS NULL AND object_revision_value >= 1
        WHEN object_type_value = 'provider_connection' THEN
            object_id_value ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
            AND object_version_value IS NULL AND object_revision_value >= 1
        WHEN object_type_value = 'agent_config' THEN
            object_id_value IN ('RESEARCH_DIRECTOR', 'FACTOR_SCIENTIST', 'STRATEGY_SCIENTIST', 'PORTFOLIO_ANALYST', 'RED_TEAM_RESEARCHER', 'PERFORMANCE_ANALYST')
            AND object_version_value IS NULL AND object_revision_value >= 1
        WHEN object_type_value = 'event_stream' THEN
            object_id_value ~ '^EVT-(?:[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$'
            AND object_version_value IS NULL AND object_revision_value >= 1
        ELSE false
    END, false);
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN false;
END;
$qf$;

functions.name: qf_event_locator_json_valid
qf_nullable_public_id_json_valid

checks.name: ck_agent_runs_next_action_closed
checks.sql:
next_action IS NULL OR (
jsonb_typeof(next_action) = 'object'
AND next_action ?& ARRAY['action','object_type','object_id','object_version','object_revision']
AND next_action - ARRAY['action','object_type','object_id','object_version','object_revision'] = '{}'::jsonb
AND jsonb_typeof(next_action->'action') = 'string'
AND qf_event_locator_json_valid(next_action, true)
)

checks.name: ck_jobs_result_ref_closed
checks.sql:
result_ref IS NULL OR (
jsonb_typeof(result_ref) = 'object'
AND result_ref ?& ARRAY['object_type','object_id','object_version','object_revision','artifact_id']
AND result_ref - ARRAY['object_type','object_id','object_version','object_revision','artifact_id'] = '{}'::jsonb
AND qf_event_locator_json_valid(result_ref, true)
AND qf_nullable_public_id_json_valid(result_ref->'artifact_id', 'ART')
)

checks.name: ck_paper_scheduler_states_suppression_invariant
checks.sql: ((scheduler_status = 'ACTIVE' AND suppressed_since_utc IS NULL) OR (scheduler_status IN ('PAUSED', 'DISABLED') AND suppressed_since_utc IS NOT NULL)) AND resume_watermark_utc IS NOT NULL
